NUTRITION
  STRATEGY "Body Recomposition (High Protein, Mild Deficit on Rest Days)":
    calories training_day 0% from maintenance
    calories rest_day -10% from maintenance
    protein 1.6..2.2 g_per_kg_bodyweight
    fat 0.8..1.0 g_per_kg_bodyweight
    carbs remainder after protein_and_fat
    fiber 25..35 g_daily
    hydration 30..40 ml_per_kg_bodyweight
    meal_timing:
      - protein 25..40 g with breakfast
      - protein 25..40 g pre_workout 1..2 h
      - protein 25..40 g post_workout within 2 h
      - protein 25..40 g with dinner
      - optional casein_like 25..35 g pre_sleep if total_protein_low
    peri_workout:
      - pre_workout carbs 0.5..1.0 g_per_kg if >60m_session
      - intra_workout water_or_electrolytes sip_as_needed
      - post_workout carbs 0.5 g_per_kg for glycogen
    weekly_checks:
      - bodyweight trend 0.1..0.3% change_per_week
      - adjust calories +/-100..150 if 2_wk trend off_target
      - prioritize pain_free_eating and adherence over precision
